import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/cameras.csv')

# Set the style of the visualization
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Create a scatter plot to visualize the relationship between megapixels and price, colored by sensor type
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))
scatter = sns.scatterplot(
    data=df,
    x='megapixels',
    y='price_usd',
    hue='sensor_type',
    style='has_video_4k',
    palette='deep',
    markers={0: 'X', 1: 'o'},
    alpha=0.7
)

# Add a regression line for each sensor type
sns.regplot(
    data=df,
    x='megapixels',
    y='price_usd',
    scatter=False,
    fit_reg=True,
    color='gray',
    ci=None
)

# Customize plot elements
plt.title('Digital Cameras: Megapixels vs. Price', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('Megapixels', fontsize=14)
plt.ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=14)
plt.legend(title='Sensor Type', bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc='upper left')

# Save the plot
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
